title: Scalar complex adjunction normalization
statement: For a morphism φ:R→S of commutative ring sheaves on the small pro-etale site of a scheme, use the ordinary and derived scalar adjunctions and their canonical complex counit [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. For any cochain complexes P over R and K over S and any map f from ordinary scalar extension of P to K, the derived transpose of the complex counit followed by q(f) equals q of the ordinary transpose followed by the inverse exact-restriction factorization. No flatness of P, K, or φ is assumed.

source.place: Tags 07A6 (lemma-adjoint), 0D6D (lemma-compose-pushforward), and the comparison argument of lemma-adjoints-push-pull-compatibility; sites-modules.tex lemma-adjoint-push-pull-modules.

proof.text: The existing resolving-class construction gives an adjunction with the unit normalization on every homotopy representative. K-flat resolutions verify the construction's resolving hypothesis. Uniqueness identifies it with the canonical scalar adjunction. Cancel the exact-restriction factorization in the unit equation. The unit formula for the Hom bijection, naturality of the restriction factorization, and functoriality of localization give the claimed transpose equation.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarComplexTranspose {T : Scheme.{u}}
    {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}} (φ : R ⟶ S)
    (P : CochainComplex (pbcModules T R) ℤ) (K : CochainComplex (pbcModules T S) ℤ)
    (f : ((pbcExtend φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P ⟶ K) :
    (pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction φ).homEquiv _ _
        (pbcComplexCounit φ P ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f) =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (((pbcScalarAdjunction φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).homEquiv P K f) ≫
        (pbcRestrict φ).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app K
